name: kids-minigames
description: Six mini-games for preschool children on Android tablets (one codebase, six APKs).

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run --silent assets && vite build
scripts.verify: npm run check:size && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew installDebug -q && adb shell monkey -p jp.impactmirai.kidsgame -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 > /dev/null 2>&1
